Review of isolated_by_closures (request_changes): The current implementation treats all closures as bidirectional by adding both (u, v) and (v, u) to the closure set. The specification states that 'matching road records are removed'. If directed=True, a closure (u, v) should only remove the road record (u, v), not (v, u). Please ensure the closure logic respects the directed/undirected nature of the network and only removes the specific road records that match the entries in the 'closed' list.
